record.body: CELL3 exact-head court resolution supersedes the immediately prior in-progress snapshot. ForcedTop25 order remains unchanged and was not reranked. autofde#33@49c55a70937763966795d41485ff35554700ee93 exact-head admission, constructor checkout, and constructor build succeeded, but Manufacture consumer subject failed; its exact-head R80 owning court is FAILURE, so Q=false and state remains COMPATIBLE_NOT_READY despite Self-Manufacturing Crown SUCCESS. xaas#32@a0660ef4f30154e4f0a3b1d509f71628849b46cd failed at the same Manufacture consumer subject transition after successful admission/build, and native CI/CD Elixir is independently FAILURE; Q=false and COMPATIBLE_NOT_READY. autofde-lab#88@3dd9cce318711533b00f0cf36c941b3d15d14d29 remains REQUALIFYING with general PR CI SUCCESS and its owning R80 court still IN_PROGRESS. The shared failure transition is therefore evidence of a reusable manufacture-boundary defect, not three independent compatibility rejections; return it upstream through canonical GGEN repair before another unchanged rerun. ready_set remains empty. No READY target is starved. Consequential DO=false.
